body:
## [3.112.0] - 2026-11-18

### Features

- add batch printing and employee attendance tools
- refresh dated prices and apply cached quantity tiers
- add explicit pricelist ID handling in customer DTO and related services
- size location numbers independently of barcodes
- print warehouse location barcodes

### Bug Fixes

- retain explicit customer prices during full sync
- normalize option charges in verified draft prices
- recover legacy option charges and verify fallback totals
- preserve quantity tiers in catalog snapshot staging
- recover customer assignments and preserve scoped prices
- align Z report trading-day table (AIONE-596)
- display active branch prices across POS catalogs and search
- retain explicit pricelist in legacy cart decoding
- wait for branch policy before customer fallback
- preserve explicit customer pricelist after editing
- reserve more height for location barcode bars
- print the location number above the barcode

### Other Changes

- isolate widget fixtures and update catalog query assertion
- Table data is now bold again. Headers remain bold, and the column layout stays the same.
- Updated the Z-number header and values to align at the column’s start: left in English, right in Hebrew.
- restore test release documentation replay
- exclude scratch artifacts and unrelated dependency changes from AION-854
- Implement branch pricing feature and related tests
- skip automatic refresh while report is loading
